records.text: A May 4, 2011 article said a cohort going to Romania included two Nevada graduates and two University of Texas graduates who were not yet enrolled in the graduate program.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Check out this article. I can't even make this up. It says this year, it says Romania students will give lessons at schools and help teachers. ... You can note that date in the corner, May 4th, 2011. And this year's cohort of students includes two Nevada graduates. ... No clarity. Oh, yes, there is some clarity. They're not yet formally enrolled in the graduate program, but they're going out there anyway.

verification.notes: The transcript supplies a detailed description of a purported May 4, 2011 article, but the original article or an independent archive could not be located to confirm the students, schools, or enrollment status.

records.text: Owens said footage from October 8 at the University of Nevada in Reno showed Charlie Kirk wearing the wireless microphone inside his shirt.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Suddenly on October 8th at the University of Nevada in Reno, Charlie (Charlie Kirk) has it on the inside of his shirt.

verification.notes: The October 8, 2024 UNR event is documented, but live searches did not yield authenticated footage sufficient to determine the precise inside-shirt microphone placement.
